title: AMD GCN, Polaris and Vega (gfx803, gfx900, gfx906)

general.summary: llama.cpp with Vulkan: ROCm has dropped or deprecated these chips, Vulkan still runs them well.
general.notes: Training runs on the CPU (or an older ROCm 5.x stack for gfx906, unsupported). Inference and activation extraction (cett-dump) work through Vulkan.

author: OmniCortex
